EV uses Bluetooth peripherals you explicitly pair (health belt, accessories) for presence and readiness.
EV resolves contacts only when you ask it to (address texts/calls by name).

EV reads heart rate, HRV, sleep, SpO2, respiratory rate, and activity from Apple Health (including your Amazfit Helio Strap via Zepp) so the vitals lookout and emergency pulse can work — read-only, nothing is written back.
EV connects to your Mac's EV API over your local network/Tailscale.
EV uses the microphone for live conversation while the app is open, and when you press the mic button.
EV uses Face ID to confirm sensitive actions independently of the voice session.
EV uses the camera when you ask it to look, take a photo, or record a video.
EV reads photos you explicitly choose to attach to a memory.
EV saves photos and videos you ask it to capture into your library.
EV uses your location only while you are actively using a location-aware card.
EV uses Siri/App Intents only for shortcuts you create (e.g. quick capture).
EV uses on-device speech recognition for quick dictation capture when you enable it.
